fullPassage: Moral excellence, according to Aristotle, is the result of habit and repetition, though modern science would also suggest that it may have an innate, genetic component. This means that moral excellence will be broadly set early in our lives, which is why the question of how early to teach it is so important. Freud suggested that we don’t change our personality much after age five or thereabouts, but as in many other things, Freud was wrong. A person of moral excellence cannot help doing good — it is as natural as the change of seasons or the rotation of the planets. Recent psychological research shows that personality traits stabilize around age thirty in both men and women and regardless of ethnicity as the human brain continues to develop, both neuroanatomically and in terms of cognitive skills, until the mid-twenties. The advantage of this new understanding is that we can be a bit more optimistic than Aristotle and Freud about being able to teach moral excellence.

Freud suggested that we don’t change our personality much after age five or thereabouts, but as in many other things, Freud was wrong. A person of moral excellence cannot help doing good — it is <u>as natural as the change of seasons or the rotation of the planets</u>. Recent psychological research shows that personality traits stabilize around age thirty in both men and women and regardless of ethnicity as the human brain continues to develop, both neuroanatomically and in terms of cognitive skills, until the mid-twenties. The advantage of this new understanding is that we can be a bit more optimistic than Aristotle and Freud about being able to teach moral excellence.
questions.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 "as natural as the change of seasons or the rotation of the planets"가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '계절의 변화나 행성의 회전만큼 자연스러운'이라는 표현의 함축
det.analysis:
✅ ① 도덕적으로 탁월한 사람에게 선행은 의식적 노력 없이 저절로 이루어지는 것이다 — 자연 현상처럼 불가피하고 자연스러운 것
❌ ② 도덕적 탁월함은 자연과학으로만 설명할 수 있다 — 비유의 뜻 오해
❌ ③ 선행은 계절처럼 특정 시기에만 나타난다 — 주기성 아닌 자연스러움 비유
❌ ④ 도덕적 행동은 과학 법칙처럼 예측 가능하다 — 예측 가능성이 아닌 자연스러움
det.tip: as natural as = ~만큼 자연스러운 (의식적 노력 없이 저절로)
